desc:
📦 Welcome to Steal a Delivery! 🚚

How to Play:
📦 Steal deliveries from vans
🏃 Escape the drivers
🥷 Steal deliveries from other players
🎁 Open boxes for rare items
💰 Auction your loot or keep it
⬆️ Upgrade your speed, cash offers and more
✨ Discover rare boxes, items, sizes, and mutations!

🎮 Supports Desktop, Console, Mobile, and Tablet players
